title: Stopping every worker
hints: Sending one value on quit wakes exactly one worker. Closing quit wakes all of them, because a closed channel is always ready to receive from.
stop must also wait until every worker has really exited, so that work is never called after stop returns. Track the workers with a sync.WaitGroup.
stop := func() { close(quit); wg.Wait() }  — and each worker: defer wg.Done(); for { select { case <-quit: return; default: work(id) } }
